messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you sell your acoustic guitar quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace old strings if needed. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and fetches a higher price. | | **2. Document Condition** | Note any scratches, dents, fret wear, or hardware issues. | Transparency builds trust with buyers and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **3. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the front, back, sides, headstock, neck, and any flaws. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract more views and help justify your asking price. | | **4. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. | Knowing the going rate helps you price competitively. | | **5. Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
• Brand & model
• Year (if known)
• Condition summary
• Key features (e.g., wood type, pickups)
• Reason for selling
• Asking price (or “price negotiable”)
• Contact method | A detailed description reduces back‑and‑forth and speeds up the sale. | | **6. Choose Your Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, global reach.
• **eBay** – auction or fixed price, large audience.
• **Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music stores** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; listing on multiple sites maximizes exposure. | | **7. Set a Realistic Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting price can still land you your goal. | | **8. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup** – no shipping cost, safer for high‑value items.
• **Shipping** – use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking. | Shipping adds risk and cost; local pickup is safer for both parties. | | **9. Prepare for Negotiation** | Decide your lowest acceptable price beforehand. | Being prepared keeps you from underselling or feeling pressured. | | **10. Meet Safely (if local)** | • Meet in a public place (coffee shop, library, police station).
• Bring a friend or family member if possible.
• Bring a small bag of cash or a prepaid Venmo/PayPal link. | Safety first—never meet in a secluded area or accept a stranger’s money in cash. | | **11. Finalize the Sale** | • Sign a simple bill of sale (include date, price, and both parties’ signatures).
• Transfer any warranties or serial numbers. | A bill of sale protects both parties and provides a record of the transaction. | | **12. Follow Up** | • Ask the buyer for feedback (if using a platform that allows it).
• Keep a copy of all correspondence. | Feedback improves future listings; records help resolve disputes. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: List early in the week; people browse more on weekends. - **Price Flexibility**: If you’re in a hurry, consider a “sell me fast” discount. - **Safety**: Never accept a check or wire transfer from an unknown buyer. - **Shipping**: Use a sturdy case or a padded box, and insure the package for its full value. ### Example Listing (Reverb) > **Title**: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description**: > • Brand: Yamaha > • Model: FG800 > • Year: 2015 (approx.) > • Wood: Spruce top, mahogany back & sides > • Condition: Minor fret wear, no cracks, new strings installed. > • Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string. > • Asking price: $350 (negotiable). > • Shipping: Will ship via UPS Ground, insured. > • Local pickup available in Seattle. > **Photos**: [Attach 5–6 high‑resolution images] > **Contact**: Email or Reverb messaging. Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We can provide steps: research market value, clean and maintain, take good photos, list on platforms (e.g., eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips, etc. Also mention potential for trade-in, consignment, or local music stores. Provide tips for negotiation, safe transaction, etc. The user didn't ask for a function call. So no function call needed. Just answer.
